identity.title: With TAG TEAM Pokémon-GX, the Pokémon TCG Will Never Be the Same!

leadText:
With TAG TEAM Pokémon-GX, the Pokémon TCG Will Never Be the Same! (Japanese: TAG TEAM GX) is an animated trailer announcing the introduction of . It revealed the card Pikachu & Zekrom-GX as well. 

It was first shown during the opening ceremony of the 2018 World Championships. The trailer was posted on the Western and Korean Pokémon YouTube channels and the Pokémon Card Channel on August 24, 2018, and on the Japanese YouTube channel on November 30, 2018.
plainText:
With TAG TEAM Pokémon-GX, the Pokémon TCG Will Never Be the Same! (Japanese: TAG TEAM GX) is an animated trailer announcing the introduction of . It revealed the card Pikachu & Zekrom-GX as well. 

It was first shown during the opening ceremony of the 2018 World Championships. The trailer was posted on the Western and Korean Pokémon YouTube channels and the Pokémon Card Channel on August 24, 2018, and on the Japanese YouTube channel on November 30, 2018.

==Plot==
The early parts of this video are rendered in a series of static pencil sketches that are gradually drawn into the frame. The first shot depicts the drawer and their pencil.

A in a field with flowers in it notices the Legendary Pokémon . They against each other. Afterward, the two become friends and practice their -type attacks together. 

At this point, the trailer incorporates light animation. 

Both Pikachu and Zekrom walk down a tunnel.

The sketches gradually gain color for the remainder of the trailer.

The end of the tunnel reveals a stadium, which Pikachu & Zekrom stride into. The two dive into battle, with Zekrom entering Overdrive Mode. 

The final shot is given increasing amounts of detail. The frame corners float into view, while the TAG TEAM label spins into existence next to the upper-left frame corner. With a flash, both the art and the frame are combined, forming the Pikachu & Zekrom-GX card. Lightning streaks across the background and foreground.

One last bolt of lighting transitions to the "GX TAG TEAM" logo.

The story from this trailer appears to continue in the Use the Buddy System in Pokémon TCG: Sun & Moon—Team Up! trailer.
